rv.q: Sutton Foster, who paid her dues in bit parts and understudy roles, was the study who stepped into the title role a week before previews last winter at La Jolla Playhouse.

For "Millie's" Foster, it was a Cinderella inspired victory. The 27-year-old actress, originally an understudy, was elevated to the starring role just before the musical began its tryout at California's La Jolla Playhouse in 2000. "To say that this is a dream come true is an understatement," said the overwhelmed Foster.
